description: This Java source file implements the DefaultDittoJsonHandler class, which extends DittoJsonHandler and provides JSON parsing and construction functionalities using builder patterns. It handles creation of JSON arrays and objects, and processes various JSON value types such as null, boolean, string, and number, with utility methods for parsing and escaping strings.

classes.name: DefaultDittoJsonHandler
classes.description: A thread-unsafe handler class for constructing JSON structures, implementing start/end methods for JSON arrays and objects, and handling different JSON value types.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of DefaultDittoJsonHandler.

methods.name: startArray
methods.description: Initializes a new JSON array, returning an empty list.

methods.name: startObject
methods.description: Initializes a new JSON object, returning an empty list.

methods.name: endString
methods.description: Handles string JSON values, with escaping.

methods.name: endNumber
methods.description: Handles numeric JSON values, parsing strings to appropriate number types.

methods.name: endArrayValue
methods.description: Adds a JSON value to the current array's list.

methods.name: endArray
methods.description: Finalizes the array, updating the string builder and JSON value.

methods.name: endObjectValue
methods.description: Adds a JSON field to the current object.

methods.name: endObject
methods.description: Finalizes the object, creating a JSON object value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current JSON value being constructed.
